text:
harper: ok, small very important poll: i fed the sandbox LLM a prompt to invent 'office zodiac signs' for our desk objects and it assigned horoscopes. results are hilarious.
drew: please tell me my keyboard is 'Capricorn: reliable but occasionally dramatic'
leena: paste the list!!
harper: pasted (abridged):
- Mug (Taurus): steadfast, bonds over coffee, demands warm respect.
- Keyboard (Capricorn): tactile perfectionist; secretly judges fast typists.
- Monitor (Leo): loves center-of-desk attention and dramatic wallpapers.
- Plant (Pisces): empathetic, gives life advice during standups.
- Mouse (Gemini): quick, easily distracted, has dual-mode personalities.
kai: the Monitor as Leo is cursedly accurate. my wallpaper is inappropriate.
leena: we should make desktop horoscopes a weeklong event. poll: which desk object gets a zodiac-themed nameplate? A) Mug B) Keyboard C) Monitor D) Plant
plant-bot: Poll created: react with :one: :two: :three: :four: (expires in 7h)
drew: also the LLM added compatibility advice: "Keyboard and Plant: maintain gentle adjacency; Monitor and Mug: avoid spills; Mouse and Keyboard: schedule weekly reconciliation."
harper: compatibility advice is peak folklore. can someone put these in the fic channel as 'Deskomancy'?
leena: adding a weekend sticker pack: zodiac emojis for mugs and monitors.
kai: note: do not actually follow the 'avoid spills' rule unless you like cleanups. also, plant still prefers water not coffee.
plant-bot: Reminder: "Water the fic plant" scheduled 10:00 AM tomorrow  @leena
harper: this is the most delightful emergent behavior. next experiment: ask the LLM to write weekly horoscopes for the team. i predict dramatic forecasts.
